description: This file contains PHP class definitions related to parsing Smarty template tags, specifically building a parse tree for template tags within the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Tag
classes.description: Represents a complete Smarty template tag within the parse tree, capable of converting to PHP code and assigning its content to a variable.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parse tree node with parser context and data, capturing the current block nesting level.

methods.name: to_smarty_php
methods.description: Returns the stored data as Smarty PHP code.

methods.name: assign_to_var
methods.description: Generates PHP code to evaluate the buffer content and assign it to a new variable, inserting this code into the parser's prefix code.
